speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I understand you have experienced episodic cough and shortness of breath; to help you, please describe exactly when these symptoms occur and what triggers them. To start our evaluation, how long have you been experiencing these episodes?

speaker: Patient
text: 59-year-old female. The patient reports a 1-month history of episodic cough and shortness of breath. The cough is nonproductive and worsens when climbing stairs and at night. She experienced fever, sore throat, and nasal congestion 8 weeks ago.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Post-infectious bronchial hyperreactivity (likely due to a recent upper respiratory infection that began 8 weeks ago), given the 1-month history of nonproductive cough and shortness of breath triggered by exertion and occurring at night, in the absence of current fever or purulent symptoms.
